en.title: Verbs followed by infinitive or gerund
en.summary: Some verbs take the infinitive, some the gerund, and a few change meaning.

paragraphs: Some verbs are followed by the infinitive, some by the gerund, and some by either.

items: I **like** reading and I **like** to read. (both)

paragraphs: A few verbs change meaning with the form. Stop doing means to end an action, and stop to do means to pause in order to do something. Remember and forget work in a similar way.

blocks.html:
VerbMeaningExample
stop + gerundend the actionHe stopped smoking.
stop + infinitivepause to do somethingHe stopped to smoke.
remember + gerundrecall the pastI remember meeting her.
remember + infinitivenot forget toRemember to lock the door.
